scripts.dev: bun run types:engine && bun run --parallel --elide-lines 0 --filter sliver-engine --filter ramen-empire dev
scripts.build: bun run build:engine && bun run build:game
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:engine && bun run typecheck:game
scripts.test: bun run types:engine && bun run --parallel --no-exit-on-error --filter sliver-engine --filter ramen-empire test:unit
scripts.test:game: bun run types:engine && bun run --cwd games/ramen-empire test:unit
